Scholarships
Current and Incoming Students
Each year, support from alumni and corporate partners allows the college to award
scholarships to eligible students. Awards may recognize academic achievement, leadership,
community involvement, financial need, an interest in community pharmacy, and other
qualifications.
During the 2025–2026 academic year, the college awarded more than $900,000 in scholarships
to support students as they pursued their education and career goals.

Incoming Students
The Barry and Judy Silverman College of Pharmacy offers scholarships to qualified
incoming students in recognition of their academic achievement, professionalism, and
dedication to excellence in pharmacy. Scholarship availability and award amounts vary.
The college’s Scholarship Subcommittee automatically reviews all incoming students
for scholarship consideration at the time of acceptance. No separate inquiries are
required.
If the Scholarship Subcommittee invites a student to apply for a scholarship, the
Admissions Office will contact the student by telephone and follow up by email with
the application and further instructions.
Testimonials
Receiving this scholarship has helped reduce my financial stress by covering a portion
of my tuition. With this financial support, I have been able to reduce my work hours
and rely less on student loans to fund my education. This has given me more time to
focus on my coursework and prepare for my future career as a pharmacist. I am very
grateful to NSU for providing this support and investing in my education and future.
Valerie Castellanos | Class of 2030 | Fort Lauderdale/Davie Campus | NSU Alumna | Dean’s Scholarship Recipient
To the donors who made the Dean's Scholarship possible: thank you, truly. Your generosity
eases the financial weight of school and lets me focus on what I came here to do:
learn, grow, and become a pharmacist who makes a real difference for patients in Puerto
Rico. I'm grateful for your belief in students like me, and I hope to one day pay
that kindness forward.
Bianca S. Umpierre Ramos | Class of 2030 | San Juan Campus University of Puerto Rico - Rio Piedras Alumna | Dean’s
Scholarship Recipient
I am so thankful for the opportunity of being selected as the recipient of this Scholarship.
This has been a blessing making it possible to further my education. As well as giving
me financial security and help with my living expenses and my university supplies.
This has truly motivated me to maintain my academic grade and performance. It has
allowed me to participate in extracurriculars activities that also help me develop
my skills in the field I intend to grow in.
Alondra D. Figueroa Hernández | Class of 2030 | San Juan Campus | University of Puerto Rico at Bayamón Alumna | Barry
and Judy Silverman College of Pharmacy Scholarship Recipient
Because of this scholarship, I’m able to redirect more of my time towards growing
as a professional and studying, as well as more time with the people I cherish. This
scholarship has helped me alleviate the financial stress that comes with pursuing
a career in pharmacy, and I’m honored to have been awarded this aid.
Jose Quinones Soto | Class of 2030 | San Juan Campus | University of Puerto Rico at Aguadilla Alumnus |
Dean’s Scholarship Recipient
Current Students
Current students receive scholarship information by email, including details on opportunities,
eligibility requirements, and the application process. A student orientation session
is typically held in February to mark the beginning of the annual scholarship application
cycle.
The Student Scholarship Committee evaluates applications and provides scholarship
recommendations to the Dean. The Dean notifies scholarship recipients at the beginning
of the academic year (Fall).
These scholarship opportunities are made possible through the generous support of
organizations such as Walgreens, CVS, and Publix, as well as private donors who are
committed to supporting our students and their academic success.
Testimonials
As an international student, financing my education has been extremely burdensome
because I am not eligible for federal student loans and have had to rely solely on
private loans to finance my tuition. Receiving the Barry and Judy Silverman Endowed
Scholarship has provided meaningful financial relief, helping to reduce some of that
burden and allowed me to focus on my education without carrying the full weight of
those concerns on my own. With the scholarship, I am able to continue my pharmacy
education with less financial strain and greater focus on completing my degree. It
has given me additional financial flexibility during a demanding stage of my professional
education. I am truly grateful to the donors for recognizing the financial challenges
students can face while pursuing a professional degree and choosing to provide meaningful
support. Your generosity has made a tangible difference in my educational journey,
and I sincerely appreciate the opportunity to continue pursuing my PharmD with this
assistance.
Colleen Blake Bramwell | Advanced Standing | Class of 2027 | Ft. Lauderdale/Davie Campus | Barry and Judy Silverman
Endowed Scholarship Recipient
The Barry and Judy Silverman Endowed Scholarship has greatly reduced my financial
concerns and has allowed me to further focus on my academic accomplishments and growing
as a professional and leader. Because of this scholarship, I am able to focus on
my academics and not worry about financial burdens. I would like to thank Mr. and
Mrs. Silverman for their generosity. They inspire me to work hard and to give back
to those in need.
Paige Altaffer | Entry Level | Class of 2028 | Ft. Lauderdale/Davie Campus | Barry and Judy Silverman
Endowed Scholarship Recipient
Receiving the Barry and Judy Silverman Endowed Scholarship has significantly reduced
the financial strain of pharmacy school, empowering me to dedicate my full attention
to my coursework and clinical rotations. Because of this scholarship, I am able to
focus entirely on building a strong clinical foundation and pursuing my pharmacy career
goals without the heavy burden of financial stress. Thank you for your remarkable
generosity and for investing in my potential as a future pharmacist. I will always
value your support and sincerely hope to one day pay it forward to future pharmacy
students, just as you have helped me.
Brandon Hernandez | Entry Level | Class of 2027 | Ft. Lauderdale/Davie Campus | Barry and Judy Silverman
Endowed Scholarship Recipient
Thanks to the Barry and Judy Silverman Endowed Scholarship, I am able to remain focused
on my education and professional development, as this generous award has helped alleviate
the financial burden associated with completing my PharmD. As I continue through my
final year of pharmacy school and clinical rotations, this support allows me to dedicate
more of my time and energy to gaining the knowledge and experiences that will prepare
me for my future career. With greater financial peace of mind, I can continue pursuing
my academic and professional goals while focusing on successfully completing my PharmD.
I am incredibly grateful to the donors whose generosity has supported my academic
journey and invested in my future as a pharmacist.
Andrea I. Baerga Cuebas | Entry Level | Class of 2027 | San Juan Campus | Barry and Judy Silverman Endowed Scholarship
Recipient
Receiving the Pharmacy Achievement Scholarship for the Fall 2026 semester has eased
the financial pressures of pursuing my Doctor of Pharmacy degree and allowed me to
focus more fully on my education. It reminds me that my dedication and hard work are
recognized and motivates me to continue growing as a future pharmacist. Because of
this scholarship, I am able to devote more time and energy to my coursework, clinical
training, and goal of becoming a compassionate, knowledgeable pharmacist. I am deeply
grateful to the donors whose generosity has made this opportunity possible. Your support
is an investment not only in my education but also in the patients and communities
I hope to serve.
Nashalisse Fernandez Otero | Entry Level | Class of 2027 | San Juan Campus | Pharmacy Achievement Scholarship Recipient
Receiving the Barry and Judy Silverman College of Pharmacy Endowed Scholarship has
been a tremendous honor and has helped alleviate the financial responsibilities associated
with pursuing my Doctor of Pharmacy degree. This support has allowed me to focus on
my education, clinical rotations, and professional development in my path to becoming
a pharmacist. Because of this scholarship, I am able to dedicate more time to strengthening
my clinical knowledge, gaining valuable patient care experiences, and pursuing my
professional goals. I am sincerely grateful to the generous donors who have invested
in my education and believed in my potential. Your generosity inspires me to continue
striving for excellence and to make a meaningful difference in the lives of my future
patients.
Yoemmariel Serrano Natal | Entry Level | Class of 2027 | San Juan Campus | Barry and Judy Silverman Endowed Scholarship
Recipient
